worked: **What didn't:** shipped code twice without rendering its target state (stale marker, tail-trim) and got indicted for both. Relayed a sub-agent report to the owner in the report's internal numbering — user-facing messages must resolve every reference from the message itself. Ran the skill the words named instead of hearing "handoff for another agent" (5th literal-over-intent recurrence): when a surface has had 2+ critique rounds and the owner mentions another agent, the deliverable is a handoff document.

**Gotchas:** (a) `color-mix` computed styles serialize as `color(srgb 0-1)` — contrast math dividing by 255 twice produces garbage both directions. (b) A payload-dedup guard + inline styles = theme toggles that silently don't restyle (catalog C12). (c) A pseudo-element on a space-between flex container is a third anonymous item — markers go inside a child span. (d) chrome-devtools `resize_page` can be inert on a tab carrying another context's device-metrics override; prove element-level behavior with dispatched resize events instead. (e) `jq`: inside `($x | f(...))` the dot rebinds to $x. (f) A concurrent session's `git add -A` can sweep your uncommitted files into its commit — state true provenance in your next commit message. (g) Forked background skills can drop their invocation args; resume them via SendMessage with explicit paths.

**Notes for future agents:** the kanban system is fully live — verbs: init/sync/add/move/verify/link/show/notes/drop/unregister/status/check; tagged notes grammar in lib.ts `parseNoteTags` (mirrored in board.html and session-start-line.sh — keep in sync); `agent-experience-actions.md` Phases 8.1b-14 is the standing regression suite, re-run after ANY kanban change; the session-start line announces boards + unread notes in board projects automatically.
